noun_definition: Thread refers to a sequence of messages that can be created in response to a deleted message within a conversation in the Expensify app, specifically when the app is used in offline mode.
Message refers to a piece of communication sent within a conversation in the Expensify app that can be deleted and subsequently interacted with in a thread.

offline mode refers to the state in which the application is used without an active internet connection, allowing users to perform actions such as deleting messages and creating threads for those messages despite being offline.
